name: pi-ai-modern-fixture
description: A SEPARATE install of pi-ai 1.x, used only by the outgoing-body matrix to prove the modern (0.87+/1.x) branch against a real 1.x api. Pinned to the same generation the 0.2.2-rc.1 host ships (1.3.0), so the modern proof runs against the shipped line rather than a stand-in.
